notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-Q10_1 'Wandering stock next ...km' warning sign (2011/2023, rev E, page 1 of 2), fully dimensioned, one size 2600 x 1500, R200. Border from the sheet's vectors and the '60' / '20' dims: white edge 20 + black border 40. Vertical chain 170 / 40 / 120D / 40 / 195 / 180D / 120 / 180D / 150 / 140D-120Em / 165 = 1500: station panel (black rectangle) y 170, 200 tall with its 120D name in white (cap top 210), WANDERING cap top 565, STOCK 865, NEXT line 1195 (NEXT and the numeral 140 Series D, km 120 Series E modified lower case, one baseline 1335). Horizontal: WANDERING 130 from the left sign edge (the sheet's '130'), and the sheet centres STOCK and the NEXT line on WANDERING (measured: centres 824 / 824 / 839 on the drawn sign), so the three lines are centred on cx = 130 + 1331.1 / 2 = 795.55; NEXT-line word gaps 122 and 62 measured from the sheet; the station panel is centred on the sign (drawn 1888 wide, i.e. 75 each side of the name; the width is not dimensioned, taken as drawn). Inset W5-38A diamond (600 side, 848.53 bounding, 10 yellow edge + 20 black border, r 40, as the 600 row of the QLD W-series tables) with its right corner 130 from the sign edge and its bottom corner 200 above the bottom edge (the sheet's '200'; drawn at 144) -> bbox x 1621.47, y 451.47; drawn as polygons. Stock symbol = the sheet's own vector (tools/symbols/qld_w5-q10-1_stock.svg), placed as drawn on the inset diamond (centred, 554.1 x 316.7). Station / property name: 'insert appropriate station / property name' with no list, so the sheet's example DULKANINNA STATION is generated (note 2; * marker not legend); distance 'NEXT X km' (40 shown, dashed) generated for 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50 km, the distances used in Queensland practice. The sheet's two examples (no station panel: height reduced by 300; no NEXT line: legend centred vertically) are not generated: their chains are not dimensioned. Black and white with the yellow / black diamond on retroreflective white.
